parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> This parameter is available only in hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query instance ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: milliseconds.
